verdict.rationale: Cognee's documented MCP support is server-side only: Cognee MCP exposes its memory to MCP-compatible assistants like Claude, Cursor and Cline. Nothing in the pack shows Cognee acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers and uses their tools. A memory/agent platform could plausibly ship client support, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
